IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CIVIL APPEAL  NO(S).  8081/2013
THE CHAIRMAN UCO BANK & ORS.                      APPELLANT(S)
                                VERSUS
SANWAL SINGH (DEAD) BY L.RS.
RESPONDENT(S)
J U D G M E N T
KURIAN, J.
Having regard to the peculiar facts of this case
where the employee is no more and that he had already
retired  in  the  year  1990,  we  are  not  inclined  to
interfere with the impugned judgment.  The appeal is
hence dismissed.
2.
However,  the  submission  made  by  the  learned
counsel for the appellants that the question of law
raised in this case is covered by a decision of this
Court in Jai Singh B. Chauhan v. Punjab National Bank
and Ors., rendered on 20.07.2005, is recorded.
3.
Pending  applications,  if  any,  shall  stand
disposed of.
4.
There shall be no orders as to costs.
